market_summary: Both GBPUSD and BTCUSD are consolidating inside their respective Value Areas during the London session without volume confirmation. GBPUSD is retesting its Point of Control after an early morning recovery, while BTCUSD remains structurally soft below VWAP but congested directly above key session support. Both setups warrant a disciplined HOLD until clear breakouts occur.

signals.rationale: Evaluating the 7-point confluence checklist: 1) Volume Profile: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.32593 to VAH 1.32797) and trading right above POC (1.32738), indicating fair-value consolidation. 2) CVD: At -1,471 with a NEUTRAL label, showing a slight positive slope (+368.6) but lacking strong directional momentum. 3) Session: LONDON_SESSION (non-blocking). 4) Trend: Price is above session VWAP (1.32664) and EMA50 (1.32698), showing short-term structural recovery. 5) ATR Bands: Trading mid-to-upper channel below upper ATR (1.32808). 6) RVOL: Last bar RVOL is low at 0.655 with no recent volume spikes. 7) S/R: Recent rejection near Session High (1.32809) with forming candle stalling mid-range. GEX is null. Given price is inside the Value Area right at POC without volume expansion or directional delta confirmation, edge is low.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish holding above VWAP and EMA50
